screen-collection.note: Rail hub lists T7 Collection's three components (Gallery / Jukebox / Replays — gap doc Gaps 11/12/20: T7 Gallery system structure, T7 jukebox per-mode structure, T7 replay theater structure, all filled with WH content only, never Tekken FMVs). Live Gallery (Endings / Episodes / Unlocked tabs), jukebox per-mode choice, and replay theater ship in PR #1056 from the Collection submenu; this section is the hub entry naming the components, with BACK to the main menu where the submenu lives. Jukebox contract (audio lane #1058): UI stores one choice per mode in wh_jukebox_v1, engine reads the same key; treasure choice is stored but UNPLAYED until a treasure music call site exists (tracked gap, not faked).

screen-daily.note: Rail entry states the board rule (fixed fighter, fixed foe, one cruel modifier; streaks earn titles) and routes with a real action to the live board: game/js/online.js screen-challenges, driven by challenges.js today(). Daily challenges are grouped with the online hub in the gap doc (online.js + netplay lineage: TTT2 Player Matches, SFV Battle Lounge); no trial data is invented here.

screen-howto.note: Control grid teaches Tekken input notation per the Input_Sequence structures doc: LP1/RP2/LK3/RK4 limbs (LP1 = Left Punch = Tekken 1, RP2 = Right Punch = Tekken 2, LK3 = Left Kick = Tekken 3, RK4 = Right Kick = Tekken 4), throw chords LP1+LK3 / RP2+RK4, throw-break limb reads, strings (LP1,RP2; f+LP1; d/f+RP2; qcf+RP2). Buttons use the existing >=44px classes (btn-primary, wh-menu-btn).

screen-menu.note: T7 main menu (Base_OnlineMenu column 29.8% W, MainMenu_mc Main0..13 slot pitch), mode select (SubMenu_mc Sub0..9, Cursor_Sub 688x80 rows) and options (SW_UI_Option ListArea: Name|Value rows, PanelBase1 40px). Ratios in docs/select-redesign/T7-PROPORTIONS.md 'Menus'. screen-modewin.note: VICTORY / DEFEAT + tier / points + rank-event rows + NEXT BATTLE / RANK HALL / MAIN MENU follows the T7 result structure (T7-UI-LAYOUT.md: SW_UI_Result_Lightning win screen — vertical blue-white bolt behind huge italic WIN; rank events ride the same screen). Win-screen texture verified on PR #863 branch at teardown/tekken7-steam/pakchunk0/textures/UI_common/flash/SW_UI_Result_Lightning/Result_Lightning_02.png; it resolves on main when #863 merges.

screen-movelist.note: Move table (grouped rows: input | name | damage) built from real fighter moveset files — the same data the Create-A-Move List editor edits (packages/creation-suite/src/movelist-editor.js, PR #998 merged 2026-10-24; LP1/RP2/LK3/RK4 throughout, context validation: jumping slots take only jumping animations, crouching only crouching, standing only standing, grapple only grapple, directional only matching direction). This screen is the read view; the editor is the write view. Input notation per the Input_Sequence structures doc.

screen-online.note: Hub rows mirror the game/js/online.js hub template: QUICK MATCH (TTT2 style — instant rival), FIND LOUNGE, CREATE LOUNGE (SFV battle lounge — your rules), TOURNAMENT, DAILY CHALLENGES, BACK — routed through the existing document-level online actions; the old placeholder section shadowed that template and lacked the #online-player-line / #online-event ids the hub fills, so the hub could never open. Column structure per T7-UI-LAYOUT.md (Base_OnlineMenu dark-glass vertical list). Netcode honestly pending (signaling server); connection bars NOT claimed (online lane's work).

screen-reincarnate.note: Vessel cards (portrait + name + style + reincarnation reason) follow the T7 select-card structure (T7-UI-LAYOUT.md: 96x148 portrait cards, number bottom-right). CONTENT is Western Heart canon, not Tekken: Nine Souls death-and-rebirth (CANON.md) — death is not failure, the Trial picks vessels from how you fought, forces carry over. No Tekken equivalent is claimed for the mechanic.

screen-result.note: Result screen structure per T7-UI-LAYOUT.md (SW_UI_Result_Lightning win screen). hud-fight.note: In-fight HUD + touch pad. Tekken in-game reference: round timer top-centre, nothing drawn over it (mode badge / VERSUS chip sit below the health-bar row). Touch pad uses T8 1/2/3/4 limb notation; Heat = 2+3, Rage Art = 1+2.

hud-touch-controls.note: T8 1/2/3/4 limb notation on PS diamond (square=1,triangle=2,cross=3,circle=4); Heat=2+3, Rage Art=1+2 in rage
